page_title: FRO 2-3 LAZ | Frosinone v Lazio 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' The resulting set piece from Frosinone is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+9' Demba Seck (Frosinone) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Nadir Zortea was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Frosinone will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+9' Stefano Turati doesn't have to worry about this one. Daichi Kamada plays a pass into the feet of Taty Castellanos (Lazio), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
90+8' The ball possession is 43:57.
90+3' Wonderful pass from Daichi Kamada (Lazio) for Matteo Guendouzi, but they can't profit from it as Stefano Turati comes off his line to collect.
90+2' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence.
90+1' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) picks up a yellow card.
90+1' Frosinone fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+1' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Frosinone will take a corner.
90+1' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marco Brescianini will be replaced by Reinier (Frosinone).
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) replaces Walid Cheddira.

90' Big chance! A simple pass from Luis Alberto left Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
89' Frosinone take a short corner kick.

89' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Christos Mandas has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Frosinone.
88' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
88' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio).
86' Giovanni Martusciello prepares a substitution. Mattia Zaccagni is replaced by Daichi Kamada (Lazio).
85' Frosinone fail to score from a corner as Christos Mandas (Lazio) leaps to collect the ball.

85' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Frosinone will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

83' Luis Alberto floats a good corner into the box that Matias Vecino (Lazio) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Felipe Anderson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
82' Luis Alberto (Lazio) is about to take a corner kick.

82' Luis Alberto (Lazio) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and tries a snap shot in the vicinity of the right post, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and brushes the post. That was a fantastic reflex save. Lazio will take a corner kick.
80' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Pol Lirola will be replaced by Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone).
80' The substitution is prepared. Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Francesco Gelli.
79' Matias Soule (Frosinone) tries his luck with a shot from long range, but his effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
78' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 12:17.

74' Matias Soule slides a brilliant pass into Walid Cheddira (Frosinone), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
73' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
70' 2 - 3 GOAL! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) scores from the resulting corner kick with a stunning bicycle kick finish. He makes it 2:3.
70' The referee awards a corner and Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) goes over to take it.
70' Matias Soule (Frosinone) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Antonio Rapuano blows the whistle, Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is penalised for a foul.
68' A cross from Pol Lirola (Frosinone) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
65' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.
62' 1 - 3 Goal! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:3.
62' Luis Alberto (Lazio) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
62' Substitution. Demba Seck (Frosinone) in, Luca Mazzitelli out.

62' Luis Alberto (Lazio) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the top right corner, but Stefano Turati shows his agility and makes a save. Lazio get a corner.

61' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the top of the net, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
59' No offside! Referee Antonio Rapuano points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Lazio players.
58' Wait! Referee Antonio Rapuano has indicated he is going to review the Lazio goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
57' 1 - 2 GOAL! Luis Alberto curls the free kick into the box. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Stefano Turati and into the left side of the net. 1:2.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Taty Castellanos (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Ciro Immobile.
56' Here is a change. Danilo Cataldi is going off and Giovanni Martusciello gives the last tactical orders to Matias Vecino (Lazio).
55' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
54' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes a short free kick.
54' Adam Marusic (Lazio) makes a slide tackle, but referee Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Frosinone in a dangerous position.
52' Stefano Turati (Frosinone) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
49' Adam Marusic (Lazio) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' What an amazing save by Christos Mandas! Matias Soule (Frosinone) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the top right corner, but fails.
46' Giovanni Martusciello has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Manuel Lazzari comes on the pitch for Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
46' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Matias Soule plays a lovely pass into Pol Lirola (Frosinone), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

44' What a wasted opportunity by Ciro Immobile (Lazio)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Stefano Turati makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
43' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
41' No offside! Referee Antonio Rapuano points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Lazio players celebrate.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
40' The Lazio players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

38' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) scores with a brilliant shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Matteo Guendouzi. The score is now 1:1.
36' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
35' The injury to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
34' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' Referee Antonio Rapuano sees the trip by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
33' The linesman signals that Luis Alberto (Lazio) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
33' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) works the corner short.
30' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Frosinone.

28' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.

26' Felipe Anderson plays a short pass through to Ciro Immobile (Lazio) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
26' The linesman raises his flag. Pol Lirola (Frosinone) is adjudged offside.
25' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
25' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. Frosinone will take a free kick near the side line.
23' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' The game is interrupted now, Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Danilo Cataldi (Lazio).
21' 46:54 – the ratio of ball possession.
18' Nadir Zortea plays a short pass through to Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
16' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Antonio Rapuano no option but to blow his whistle.
16' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
15' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Nadir Zortea picks out Pol Lirola (Frosinone) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom left corner with a header from close range. 1:0.
11' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mattia Zaccagni.

8' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
8' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) prepares to take a corner kick.

7' The game is pretty dull as Frosinone are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.
6' A snap shot by Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Christos Mandas produces a good save to thwart him.

5' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
5' Great teamplay by Frosinone as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Frosinone take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
1' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Frosinone are going to take it.
1' Matias Soule (Frosinone) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Frosinone force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Frosinone will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Antonio Rapuano.
